newsitem.title: USA: CRW stake held by Fir Tree group.
newsitem.headline: CRW stake held by Fir Tree group.

text.p: A group including Fir Tree Partners said Thursday it holds a 353,203 common shares, or 6 percent, in CRW Financial Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York-based investment group said it most recently acquired 157,003 shares between March 27 and May 29 at $5.13 to $9.00 a share.
The group said it holds shares in the King of Prussia, Pa.-based company for investment purposes.
